lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 to 13 distinct vertical white stripes are visible. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, with increased compression and reduced line length observed on the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 10th stripe (counting from anterior to posterior) where the line splits toward the dorsal ridge. A potential merging of stripe segments is observed between the 4th and 5th stripes at the mid-lateral level.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripe 1 (anterior-most) is abbreviated. Stripes 11, 12, and 13 on the posterior mass are significantly shorter, terminating before reaching the ventral-most region of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density. One primary high-contrast circular spot is located on the upper lateral haunch. Two smaller, lower-contrast spots are clustered near the base of the tail.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots are present on the face below the eye and on the cheek. A prominent white chevron-like patch is visible at the base of the neck. High-contrast white patches are visible on the inner surfaces and distal regions of the limbs.
